hypothesis: REQUIRED: falsifiable research hypothesis; no improvement is presumed.
exact_change: REQUIRED: one isolated change, code/config diff, and unchanged assumptions.
expected_failure_mode: REQUIRED: conditions under which the idea should fail.
known_limitation: REQUIRED: what this comparison cannot establish.
monitoring_proposal: REQUIRED: as-of diagnostic, reference window, cadence, proposed threshold, false-alarm response; not an automatic strategy switch.

reproducibility.seeds_and_streams: REQUIRED: fixed seeds/streams or explicitly not applicable.
reproducibility.entrypoint: REQUIRED: exact offline command, failure handling, versions and outputs.

metrics: REQUIRED: primary metric, secondary diagnostics and units
comparison.cost_assumptions: REQUIRED: identical dates, execution, rebalancing, gross-notional costs and initial purchase treatment; no unequal comparisons.
comparison.pass_rule: REQUIRED: owner-chosen rule frozen before outcomes are inspected; no threshold chosen here.
comparison.fail_rule: REQUIRED: reject/defer rule including failures and missingness; no forced winner.
comparison.multiple_comparisons: REQUIRED: list all attempted variants, metrics, windows and corrections or limits on interpretation.

decision_record_requirements: After evaluation append outcome/reasons, all attempted variants and report hashes, confirmation access/consumption, and separate owner reject/adopt signoff. This template neither records results nor adopts a model.
